title: Cyberspace explorer
description: The parts of the page, which is one HTML file: what the reader sees, how a repository is read, how views are drawn and written, and the services it reaches from the reader's browser; and the Worker in worker/ that serves it and signs readers in with GitHub.

components.name: Screen
components.responsibility: Everything the reader sees: a bar across the top, a status line, a column of folders and the folder being read, with panels that open over it.

components.name: Bar
components.responsibility: The strip across the top: the brand (a link to the landing page), the repository and its ref, the Flat / Cyberspace switch (built, and hidden until Cyberspace launches), the Tokens button and Choose another repository.

components.name: Landing page
components.responsibility: Shown when no repository is given: a headline, what the browser does, the address field, an example repository and a tile for each kind of view.

components.name: Status line
components.responsibility: One line under the bar saying what is happening (listing, reading), what went wrong, or what was skipped, with at most one button for the one thing worth doing about it.

components.name: Folder column
components.responsibility: The filter, the Waiting link and the tree of folders that have .dev files, each with small icons for the kinds of view it holds.

components.name: Folder view
components.responsibility: One folder: its crumbs, name and purpose, the folders inside it as chips, a tab per kind of view and the open tab's content.

components.name: Inspector
components.responsibility: A panel at the right that holds everything a drawing says about the selected part, with its neighbours as links; in Cyberspace a floating card with the same body.

components.name: Token panel
components.responsibility: A small dialog under the Tokens button: the tokens kept, a field for a new one, what it is for, and whether to keep it after the tab closes.

components.name: Waiting view
components.responsibility: Every open decision and blocker in the repository, as two tables linked to the records.

components.name: Repository reading
components.responsibility: Turns an address into the repository's .dev files, from the reader's browser.

components.name: Address parser
components.responsibility: Splits an address into a host, a repository, a ref and a folder; anything not on github.com is tried as GitLab.

components.name: GitHub adapter
components.responsibility: Lists a GitHub repository's files and reads them, through the API with a token or from raw.githubusercontent.com without.

components.name: GitLab adapter
components.responsibility: Lists a GitLab project's files, a hundred to a page, and reads them through the GitLab API.

components.name: Loader
components.responsibility: Finds the .dev/*.json files under the folder asked for (or, where the root has a .cyberspace-explorer folder, the files in it, and nothing else), reads twelve at a time, keeps the views and knowledge files it knows and sorts each folder's files by kind.

components.name: Token store
components.responsibility: Keeps the reader's tokens by scope (a host, an owner or group, or one repository) in this tab or this browser, and picks the narrowest one around a repository.

components.name: Router
components.responsibility: Reads the part of the address after # and shows that folder, part, view, record or the Waiting view; with ~space as its last segment, Cyberspace.

components.name: Drawing
components.responsibility: Turns diagrams, use cases and journeys into SVG drawings the reader can pan, zoom and click through.

components.name: Diagram models
components.responsibility: Turns each kind of drawn view into parts, clusters and lines with their tooltips and inspector content: component, deployment, class, state, use case and user journey.

components.name: Layout
components.responsibility: Places the parts with dagre, makes room for cluster headers, packs separate pieces into rows and smooths the lines.

components.name: Renderer
components.responsibility: Writes the drawing as SVG: plates, clusters, lines, arrowheads, labels and the grid of crosses behind them.

components.name: Part interaction
components.responsibility: Lights a part's neighbours on hover, shows tooltips, selects a part into the inspector and grows a part into the page when it opens another folder.

components.name: Camera
components.responsibility: Fits a drawing to its width, and pans and zooms it with a drag, the wheel with ⌘ or Ctrl, a pinch or the buttons in its corner.

components.name: Written views
components.responsibility: Cards for capabilities, features, use cases and journeys, the table of operations, and each view's full tables, related views and sources.

components.name: Knowledge renderer
components.responsibility: Groups a folder's knowledge files as the catalogue does and shows each record as a card: badges, summary, safe Markdown, every field, origin, relationships, sources and links.

components.name: Cyberspace
components.responsibility: The second way in: the repository in 3D, over a sky and on a ground grid, in place of the folder column and view. A folder opens as a tower of glass floors, one per .dev file, with a drawn view pulled out and its city small on it; entering that floor flies down into the city, and Esc flies back up. A drawn view stands as a city of glass towers on the flat layout's ground plan; clicking a tower, plate or beacon selects it, lights its beams and neighbours, opens the inspector on it and puts it in the address. Opened by an address whose last segment is ~space; without WebGL 2 or three.js it says why and Flat shows instead.

components.name: Stage
components.responsibility: The WebGL renderer, scene and camera: stands a city's meshes (instanced glass plates and towers, merged lines, beacons and beams, a dozen draw calls) or a folder tower's (the floors as one instanced glass mesh, their edges, rails and faces as one set of lines and one of tiles, and the pulled-out floor as a drawer with its glow, its ghost slot and its city scaled down) on the ground, slides floors out and back, fades the tower out behind the city that takes its place and in again, draws a frame only when something changed and none while hidden, follows the window's size and the system's light or dark colours, lets go of the scene on leaving and of the context a minute later, and offers Restore it when the context is lost.

components.name: World builders
components.responsibility: Turn a drawn view into a city in world units, from the layout Flat draws it with (or a grid without one): groups as plates, parts as towers as tall as their beams make them, a component's or deployment's outside services as beacons, start points as discs and every edge as an arc, those between the same two parts fanned out. Turn a folder's files into a tower of floors in three groups (drawn, written, knowledge), each floor with what its top shows: a drawn view's plan from its city, a written view's cards as bars, a knowledge file's records as lines. Pure functions, tested in Node; built once per view and direction, and once per folder.

components.name: Camera rig
components.responsibility: The camera in orbit, pan and walk modes: fits the city into the room the panels leave, with the projection centred on it, and turns, pans and flies with a drag, the wheel, a pinch, the arrow keys, + and −, and F, within limits. In the tower it takes the design's opening pose, framed in the whole window and climbed for a stack taller than 24 floors, and the wheel climbs; it flies between the tower and a city, and between a city and its street, on an arc, at once with reduced motion. In the street it walks: it puts the eye 12 units from a part across the layout's flow, looking up at it, then moves it with W A S D, the arrows, Space and Z at a pace that doesn't depend on the frame rate, turns it with Alt and a drag, slides it along towers, steps it onto plates and keeps it within the city's bounds grown by 30.

components.name: Labels
components.responsibility: HTML labels over the canvas: a pill for each part, cut at 150 px, with Flat's badge or the step's glyph, and each plate's name with its number of parts; placed nearest first, pushed clear of each other and off the panels, with leaders, and faded out with distance. By a tower: each floor's kind and title left of its slot, and a bracket for each group with its name and count.

components.name: HUD
components.responsibility: The panels over the scene: over a city, the camera controls (orbit, pan, walk, zoom in and out, fit everything) and the legend, worded for the kind of view; over the tower, the folder's card (its name, path, purpose, counts of drawn, written and knowledge files, and the folders inside it) and the pulled-out floor's (its view, what its city holds, Enter the city and Slide back); in the street, in place of the city's, the breadcrumb (folder, view, plate and the part selected or ahead), the key hints, the map (plates, towers, beacons and the eye with its view cone; a click flies the eye there), the hover card by the part under the pointer, a crosshair and a vignette.

components.name: Icons
components.responsibility: The page's own icon set on a 24-unit grid, and the rules that pick a component's icon from its name.

components.name: Sign-in and my repositories
components.responsibility: On the landing page: asks the Worker whether it signs readers in, offers Sign in with GitHub (or, without the Worker, a pasted GitHub token), and fills the address box's drop-down with the reader's repositories.

components.name: Worker
components.responsibility: Serves the page at cyberspace-explorer.com, signs readers in with GitHub and reads GitHub for them with their token, which never reaches the page.

components.name: dagre 3.1.3
components.responsibility: The graph layout library, loaded from jsDelivr. Without it every view is shown as tables.

components.name: three.js 0.187.0
components.responsibility: The 3D library, core only, loaded from jsDelivr on first entry to Cyberspace. Without it Cyberspace says so and Flat shows.

components.name: Barlow typefaces
components.responsibility: Barlow, Barlow Semi Condensed and Barlow Condensed, loaded from jsDelivr; system fonts stand in without them.

components.name: GitHub
components.responsibility: api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com: the repository's tree and its files.

components.name: GitLab
components.responsibility: gitlab.com or a self-hosted GitLab that allows the page's origin: the repository tree and raw file endpoints.

components.name: Browser storage
components.responsibility: sessionStorage and localStorage in the reader's browser, where tokens are kept.
